$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (objecten-api-facade). Declares the two configuration schemas the Objecten and Objecttypen APIs read: objecttype (which register and schema a published VNG objecttype uuid stands for, design D1) and objecten_token (a token by credential reference, the principal its requests run as, and a permission per objecttype, design D3 and D6). Both are admin-only: a declaration decides what a counterparty may read and write. OpenRegisterObjectenGateway reads them in the system context.

objecttype.title: Published objecttype
objecttype.summary: Which register and schema a published objecttype stands for
objecttype.description: Publishes one schema on the Objecttypen and Objecten APIs under a fixed uuid. The mapping is declared, never inferred from a name, and the uuid stays the same when a register is rebuilt.

publishedUuid.title: Published uuid
publishedUuid.description: The uuid counterparties use for this objecttype. Keep it when the register is rebuilt.

name.title: Name
name.description: The objecttype's name on the Objecttypen API.

register.title: Register
register.description: The slug of the register the objects live in.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The slug of the schema the objects follow.

versions.title: Allowed versions
versions.description: The schema versions this objecttype answers for. Leave it empty to answer for every version.

objecten_token.title: Objecten API token
objecten_token.summary: A counterparty's token for the Objecten API, with a permission per objecttype
objecten_token.description: The key is kept in the credential store and named here by reference. Every request with this token runs as its principal, so the register's own access rules still apply.

credential.title: Credential reference
credential.description: The id of the credential that holds the key. The key itself is never stored here.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The user every read and write with this token runs as.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Per published objecttype uuid: read, or read_write.
